action_facet_args.document_text:
[1] To help, please tell me what you want to do:
[2] Option A (instructions): I’ll give step-by-step directions in Microsoft Word.
[3] Option B (I edit it): Upload the .docx file here (or paste the text) and tell me where the paragraph should go (e.g., “after the second heading” or “at the top”).
[4] If you want to insert it yourself, follow these steps in Word:
[5] 1) Open the document in Microsoft Word.
[6] 2) Click where you want the paragraph to go.
[7] 3) Paste the paragraph (Ctrl+V / Cmd+V).
[8] 4) Optional: Home → Styles to match formatting (e.g., Normal or Heading).
[9] 5) Save the file (Ctrl+S / Cmd+S).
